_fill.notes: ComfyUI API-format workflow template for the local render worker, Qwen rung (local-render-worker.plan.md L4). Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 is an INSTRUCTION-FOLLOWING EDIT model: the scaffold PNG goes in as an image the VL encoder actually reads, and preservation is asked for in language (localParams.edit.instructionFragments), not tuned as a ControlNet strength. Fill by STRING REPLACEMENT on the raw file text, then JSON.parse and POST { prompt: <the .prompt object> } to http://127.0.0.1:8188/prompt. Numeric slots are quoted placeholder strings — replace INCLUDING the surrounding quotes (e.g. '"{{WIDTH}}"' -> '1024') so the parsed JSON carries real numbers. Sampler contract is the Lightning LoRA's, not a taste knob: 4 steps, cfg 1.0, euler/simple — do not raise cfg (the negative is inert at cfg 1.0 and that is expected; steer with the positive instruction instead).

slots.{{SCAFFOLD_IMAGE}}: scaffold PNG filename previously uploaded via POST /upload/image — use the CONTROL scaffold (packet.scaffold.controlPngUrl): Qwen renders text too well, so labels on the default scaffold WILL come back legible in the paint
slots.{{PROMPT}}: localParams.edit.instructionFragments joined '. ' + localParams.promptFragments joined ', ' + the agent's beat/subject distillation (JSON-escape it)
slots.{{NEGATIVE}}: localParams.negative joined with ', ' (JSON-escape; inert at cfg 1.0, kept for graph validity and for anyone re-running at higher cfg without the Lightning LoRA)
slots.\"{{SEED}}\": render-event seed (number) — record it with the bind; recipes stay timeless

variants.identity reference: to condition on a bound character sheet (replaces the SDXL IP-Adapter rung), add another LoadImage node for the sheet PNG and wire it as "image2" on node 8 (and 9) — TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus takes image1/image2/image3, then name the character in the instruction ('the character from the reference sheet').
variants.pure dream (no scaffold): for a dream reference with no structural conditioning (shape-from-dream / vehicle-designer DREAM step), drop nodes 7 and the vae/image1 inputs on 8 and 9, and let the prompt stand alone — the graph degrades to the proven qwen-pilot t2i shape.
variants.gguf: on lower-RAM hosts swap node 1 for {"class_type": "UnetLoaderGGUF", "inputs": {"unet_name": "qwen-image-edit-2511-Q6_K.gguf"}} (needs the ComfyUI-GGUF node pack, installed by the script).
